The '''Collector Limpet Controller''' launches limpet drones that retrieve loose cargo canisters, materials, and refined mining fragments and bring them back to the ship's cargo hold.

== Overview ==

Collector limpets are one of four original Limpet Controller types (alongside [[Fuel Transfer Limpet Controller|Fuel Transfer]], [[Hatch Breaker Limpet Controller|Hatch Breaker]], and [[Prospector Limpet Controller|Prospector]]) and are core equipment for mining builds — picking up fragments blasted off asteroids — as well as for salvage, collecting cargo ejected from destroyed or looted ships. A Commander who wants to actually keep the proceeds of mining or salvage generally needs a Collector limpet running; without one, loose cargo simply drifts away unclaimed.
